title: Install GPT-controlled real-browser completion pipeline
description: Upgrade the automation control plane with GPT conversation state, a strict dependency queue, real Edge acceptance evidence, normalized runner outcomes and fail-closed recovery without changing ERP business behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Cline success produces code_ready and never directly produces completed.
Business tasks require real Microsoft Edge acceptance plus TRX, metadata, screenshots and a SHA-256 evidence manifest.
The first blocked, malformed, gated or failed task stops the queue and later tasks are not skipped.
GPT pause, resume and intent records survive in versioned project control files.
Automation contract tests, Release build and unit tests pass.

human_gate.reason: Control-plane-only migration; no ERP business logic or external system is changed.
